sources.snippet: Create the CartPole environment and understand how it works The environment 🎮 Why do we use a simple environment like CartPole-v1? As explained in Reinforcement Learning Tips and Tricks, when you implement your agent from scratch you need to be sure that it works correctly and find bugs with easy environments before going deeper.
